method: One executable selects each policy at an accepted fit. All arms retain the same zero initial wave-acceleration mean. The two experimental arms add the positive semidefinite part of target minus prior to the live wave-acceleration covariance block. Mask 1 uses the covariance of the gyro-transported startup specific-force samples in the estimated NED frame. Mask 2 uses the trace of that covariance times the identity matrix. A mask 0 run keeps the deployed covariance.
